hero.headline: Community Partners
hero.subheadline: We believe in the power of community. From our humble beginnings at Cherry Creek Farmers Market to today, partnerships have been at the heart of everything we do.

partnerships.description: We partner with event centers, breweries, and unique venues throughout Colorado.
Recurring partnerships with businesses for employee appreciation and client events.
Supporting local charities and community organizations with special pricing.
Where it all began! Still serving our community at local markets.

communityInvolvement.title: Local Sourcing
communityInvolvement.description: We partner with local farms and vendors whenever possible to support our community.

communityInvolvement.title: Charity Events
communityInvolvement.description: Discounted catering for non-profit fundraisers and community benefit events.

communityInvolvement.title: Food Donations
communityInvolvement.description: Excess food from events is donated to local shelters and food banks.

communityInvolvement.title: Youth Employment
communityInvolvement.description: Providing job opportunities and training for young people in our community.

becomePartner.headline: Become a Partner
becomePartner.description: We're always looking for great partners who share our values of quality, community, and exceptional service. Whether you're a venue, business, or organization, let's explore how we can work together.
